result.instructions: Tools for EasyBroker, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my published properties with at least two bedrooms."; "Show the contacts with a high probability that were updated this week."; "Which contact requests came in for property EB-B0579 this month?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes EasyBroker data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run easybroker_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run easybroker_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run easybroker_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. easybroker_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: easybroker_list_properties
tools.title: List properties
tools.description: List the properties in the account with filters for status, type, operation, price, bedrooms and bathrooms. Read-only. Use easybroker_get_property for full details. GET /properties.

updated_after.description: Only properties updated after this time as an ISO 8601 date-time, for example 2025-03-01T00:00:00Z.

updated_before.description: Only properties updated before this time as an ISO 8601 date-time, for example 2025-03-01T00:00:00Z.

tools.name: easybroker_get_property
tools.title: Get property
tools.description: Return the full details of one property by its id, for example EB-B0579. Read-only. GET /properties/{property_id}.

property_id.description: Property public id, for example EB-B0579.

tools.name: easybroker_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List the contacts (leads and clients) in the account, filtered by status, probability, tag, email, office, source or dates. Read-only. GET /contacts.

sources.description: Lead sources to include, for example a website domain.

created_after.description: Only contacts created after this time as an ISO 8601 date-time, for example 2025-03-01T00:00:00Z.

updated_after.description: Only contacts updated after this time as an ISO 8601 date-time, for example 2025-03-01T00:00:00Z.

updated_before.description: Only contacts updated before this time as an ISO 8601 date-time, for example 2025-03-01T00:00:00Z.

tools.name: easybroker_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Return the full details of one contact by its id. Read-only. GET /contacts/{contact_id}.

contact_id.description: Contact id as EasyBroker returns it.

tools.name: easybroker_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: Update only the fields you send on an existing contact (name, status, probability, tags, notes and more). Changes the live contact record. PATCH /contacts/{contact_id}.

contact_id.description: Contact id as EasyBroker returns it.

private_description.description: Internal note, not shown to the contact.

status.description: Contact status as the account defines it.

tags.description: Tags. Replaces the current tag list.

tools.name: easybroker_list_contact_requests
tools.title: List contact requests
tools.description: List the contact requests (enquiries about properties) received in a period or for one property. Read-only. GET /contact_requests.

happened_after.description: Only requests received after this time as an ISO 8601 date-time, for example 2025-03-01T00:00:00Z.

happened_before.description: Only requests received before this time as an ISO 8601 date-time, for example 2025-03-01T00:00:00Z.

property_id.description: Only requests for this property public id.

tools.name: easybroker_create_contact_request
tools.title: Create contact request
tools.description: Create a new contact request (a lead about a property) in the account. Each call creates a new record and can notify the agent. POST /contact_requests.

source.description: Where the lead came from, for example a website domain. Required.

name.description: Full name of the person asking.

property_id.description: Property public id, for example EB-B0579.

tools.name: easybroker_list_property_types
tools.title: List property types
tools.description: List the property types available in the account's country (for example apartment, house). Read-only. GET /property_types.

tools.name: easybroker_list_features
tools.title: List property features
tools.description: List the property features (amenities) available in the account's country. Read-only. GET /features.

tools.name: easybroker_get_location
tools.title: Find location
tools.description: Look up a location by name or postal code, with its children (neighborhoods, cities, states). Use the result when a property needs a location. Read-only. GET /locations.

tools.name: easybroker_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the active users (agents and staff) of the account. Read-only. GET /users.

tools.name: easybroker_list_collaborations
tools.title: List collaborations
tools.description: List the collaborations (shared listings between agencies) of the account. Read-only. GET /collaborations.
